answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I mistook the texture of the liquid for the nature of the substance. The heat is a fact, not a category. I will eat this; the body requires its fuel, even if the mind prefers its coffee.
answer.thought: Sunil’s correction is sharp and necessary. I was projecting my aesthetic onto his trade, treating the milk as a philosophical object rather than a culinary one. The samosa is hot and the hunger is real; the abstraction must yield to the appetite for the moment.
